suite: Iron Furnaces 0.2 final rendered GUI, arrow, item-bar and placement validation

detail.visual_review: Full green, half yellow, low red-orange bars
Inspect the captured PNGs; appearance is not asserted.

visual_review.method: Each original 1280x720 PNG was opened and inspected individually after the test run.
visual_review.notes: Some captures include the host tutorial toast above the menu; it does not obscure controls. No material visual defects were found.

factory-2-lanes-half.png.finding: Two active input/output lanes align with half-filled downward arrows; energy counter and settings are readable.

factory-4-lanes-half.png.finding: Four active input/output lanes align with half-filled downward arrows.

factory-6-lanes-half.png.finding: Six active input/output lanes align with half-filled downward arrows.

generator-active.png.finding: Active flame, fuel slot, energy meter, 40 FE/t rate and 3200/80000 FE counter render clearly.

augments-installed.png.finding: All three colored augment channels show installed items; tab return button and spare augment remain visible.

settings-configured.png.finding: Auto In, Auto Out, Auto-split and S shortcut show enabled states; redstone mode S and value 1 are legible.

heater-bound.png.finding: Bound receiver, 640000/1000000 FE label and partial energy bar render correctly in the transmitter menu.

rainbow-coal-bars.png.finding: Unused, half-used and low remaining coal show full green, half yellow and short red-orange durability bars.

furnace-idle.png.finding: Idle arrow and flame silhouettes appear directly on the furnace background, with no gray rectangle.

furnace-half.png.finding: The arrow is half filled after 20/40 ticks and the flame is active; no gray rectangle.

furnace-near-full.png.finding: The arrow is nearly full after 39/40 ticks; no gray rectangle.

furnace-complete.png.finding: After tick 40 the arrow resets and one iron ingot appears in the output; paid flame remains active.

earlier_attempts.result: Harness expected inventory but native custom menus are reported as container; assertion corrected to accept the actual menu type.

Factory, generator and controls passed; transmitter stayed on playing screen. Added normal menu opening through the native heater interaction hook. The same visual inspection also identified an inert baked S shortcut, which was wired to Auto-split. Both fixes pass in this final run.

limits: This suite verifies one integrated rendered game. It does not establish independent-client multiplayer or unrelated third-party mod compatibility.
